figurative_meaning_en: something that has been repaired or renovated for the second time
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পুরনো বাড়িটি দুমেটে হয়েছে, তাই আর বেশি দিন টিকবে না।
তার জামাটি দুমেটে, কিন্তু সে এখনও পরে বেড়ায়।
example_sentences_in_english: This old house has been mended twice, so it won't last much longer.
His shirt is twice repaired, but he still wears it.
note: Refers to traditional mending practices in Bengali households, implying temporary fixes.
